whatIs: daisyUI is a Tailwind plugin that adds component-named classes, like btn or card, so you don't build every button or card from a long list of utilities. It includes dozens of components and 35 themes, and since everything is handled with CSS classes, it works in any framework.
It's a good fit when you already work with Tailwind and want a coherent interface quickly, without designing every piece from scratch.
uses: Building a personal project's admin panel without designing every component.
Offering light and dark mode, or other themes, by changing the data-theme attribute.
Prototyping a landing page with buttons, cards and forms that already match each other.
caveats: It's installed as a Tailwind plugin, so it makes the most sense in projects that already use it.
Some interactive components need their own JavaScript: the recommended modal, for example, is opened with showModal() on a dialog element.
If you combine it with another component library, set a prefix so their classes don't clash.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license; the store sells paid templates and extras.
idealFor: Tailwind projects that need ready-made components and themes.
